rows = conn.execute("SELECT x.gia_tri, y.gia_tri FROM stat_ng2025_t017 x JOIN stat_ng2025_t139 y ON x.dia_phuong = y.dia_phuong AND x.nam = y.nam JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT canonical_name, region_name FROM admin_mapping WHERE geo_level='province') m ON x.dia_phuong = m.canonical_name WHERE x.geo_level='province' AND y.geo_level='province' AND m.region_name='Trung du và miền núi phía Bắc' AND x.nam=2024 AND x.gia_tri IS NOT NULL AND y.gia_tri IS NOT NULL").fetchall()
assert len(rows) >= 10
xs = [r[0] for r in rows]; ys = [r[1] for r in rows]
result = float(np.corrcoef(xs, ys)[0, 1])
